description: Use this to deliver an already-paid resource, or to finish a payment that is still confirming. Use get_checkout_status to read state without consuming a unit. Input: tx_hash, or offer_id, or intent_id. Returns the receipt and consumes one paid unit. It never charges.

intent_id.description: Payment intent id, when you have one instead of a transaction hash.

offer_id.description: Offer id, to finish a payment that is still confirming or to redeem remaining units.

tx_hash.description: Sepolia transaction hash from pay_and_access or from your own settled x402 payment.

name: get_receipt
title: Get receipt
